brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested two citizens from Faqqu'a village, northeast of Jenin, on Monday, Shehab Wire reported. The men had been detained by settlers while harvesting aloe on village land near a new settlement outpost.

The arrests followed the settlers' release of the two Palestinians. Authorities did not immediately announce charges or conditions of detention for the men apprehended during the incident on village agricultural land.
